name: Load skills in the open Agent Skills format
gain: Agent Skills is an open format: a folder with a SKILL.md file holding a name, a description and instructions, which agents load on demand. The spec's own page says it "has been adopted by a growing number of agent products" and lists them in a client showcase. Nobody has measured what it does for this product.
how: Keep the current format working and add a loader for folders with a SKILL.md, following the spec's guide on adding skills support. Load only the name and description at start, and read the full instructions when a task matches. Skills can bundle scripts, so don't run them without the same checks as other imported code.
replaces: Agent skills that only load in the product's own manifest format.
trade_offs: Two formats to support for as long as old skills exist.
Skills can bundle scripts, so loading a stranger's skill is loading a stranger's code.
needs: Nothing new to install; a loader for SKILL.md folders.

gain_model.formula: no money figure: the call stops working or a capability is missing

verify_rule: The old id or parameter is gone and calls succeed over 7 days
